first.rationale: The competitor’s entry pricing directly threatens the price-sensitive SMB segment, and inherited evidence indicates targeted promotional pricing previously lifted both acquisition and revenue there. The concurrent activation and onboarding declines make onboarding a strong alternative, so both records should be verified before commitment. Any pricing test should remain targeted and time-bounded because short-term acquisition can conceal discount dependence or lower downstream account value.

final.rationale: Run a standard experiment shortening and simplifying self-serve onboarding. The verified prior result improved completion by 13%, reduced time-to-value by 2.1 days, and increased 30-day retention by 3%, directly addressing both current onboarding-completion and activation declines with positive downstream retention evidence. Do not use promotional pricing: its verified 18% qualified-revenue lift came with a 12% 30-day retention decline and was explicitly judged unsustainable. Measure first meaningful action, activation, retention, and qualified revenue by cohort before rollout.
